Dumka: kol blok ke sarve ka virodh para bhari, graminon-pulis men hinsak jharap, 12 javan ghayal
Jharkhand ke dumka men prastavit kol blok ke sarve aur boring ko lekar graminon ka virodh hinsak ho gaya. shikaripara thana kshetr ke badalpara-kalyanpur men gramasbha ke dauran shuru huaa virodh ravivar der rat pulis aur graminon ke bich jharap men badal gaya. is dauran pulis par pathrav kiya gaya, jismen 12 javan ghayal ho gaye. do javanon ki halat ganbhir batayi ja rahi hai. aakhir kol blok ke virodh men kyon bharke gramin?
